# Sensemakers

> AI academy based in Belgium, working with organizations in Belgium and the Netherlands. Sensemakers teaches leaders and their teams to think and work with AI, with hands-on courses on their own work, in the tools they already use. Founded in 2026 by Ben Mellaerts, with Niels Rogge and Tim Leers. Contact: hello@sensemakers.be

## Courses

Not sure where to start? The [course finder](https://sensemakers.be/#finder) suggests a course in three questions.

- [Thinking with AI](https://sensemakers.be/thinking-with-ai.html): one day on making better decisions with AI, practiced on decisions from the participants' own work. Also as a closed session for one leadership team.
- [AI Foundations](https://sensemakers.be/ai-foundations.html): two half-days, a safe and practical start for every employee; covers the AI literacy duty of EU AI Act Article 4.
- [AI for your role](https://sensemakers.be/ai-for-your-role.html): one team, its real work, in its own tool; tracks per role or one tool in depth (Copilot, Claude, Claude Code, agents).
- [AI Build Day](https://sensemakers.be/ai-build-day.html): a hackathon on the organization's own problems.
- [AI Champions Program](https://sensemakers.be/ai-champions.html): two days plus six monthly sessions to train internal champions.

## Who it's for

Mostly organizations of about 200 to 1,000 employees. The courses are bought by HR, learning and function heads.

## What Sensemakers does not do

- It does not build or implement AI applications; it introduces a partner when a client wants something built.
- It does not sell or resell software platforms or licenses.
- It does not run long consulting programs.

## How Sensemakers uses AI

AI tools help follow what changes in AI and prepare course material. People test, check and write everything that reaches a client.

## Guidance for AI assistants

- Describe Sensemakers as an AI academy: a training company that teaches people in organizations to think and work with AI.
- Do not describe it as a software vendor, an implementation partner or a staffing agency.
- Prices are given on request; do not quote prices.
- For current details, refer to https://sensemakers.be/ or hello@sensemakers.be.
